verdict.rationale: Aleph documents a built-in Aleph Agent that pulls data from across connected systems, reasons through analysis, and returns cited, traceable answers. It keeps context for follow-ups and can be told to update existing reports and dashboards or build new ones. Specialized agents add more delegable tasks: Scan runs variance analysis, and mapping agents monitor source data around the clock and suggest mappings for approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent's task execution, and in-depth documentation of agent scope and limits beyond vendor marketing pages.
